title: Julius Caesar — Act 1 Master Course & Study Book (ICSE)
subtitle: Text • Roman history • line-by-line teaching • character masterclasses • themes • devices • keyword vault • quotation bank • scene connections • ICSE examiner training
meta_html:
Prepared for an ICSE Class 10 student · Based on the verified Shakespeare text (Folger / Globe editions) · Cross-checked against Plutarch and modern Roman history · Aligned to the CISCE Literature in English paper
Act 1 is the Class IX portion of the syllabus; the Class X board paper (Acts III–V) depends on it at every turn. This book teaches Act 1 from zero to examination standard.
